title: Mini Dark Crosshair
description: this resource pack adds a mini scope to the Minecraft game
body:
this resource pack adds a mini sight for the game Minecraft

Pros of the Mini Sight:

1 - Pleasant to the eyes 2 - More screen space 3 - More modern sight

This sight is suitable for players who are tired of the old sight in Minecraft![Crosshair](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b55e294a8a0000ece230dabef7e45a3a1735e9f8.png)
